Affrancian Uplands: The green hills of the Uplands are home to some of the most major South Affrancian cities, including its capital; the harbor-city of Délaen.
Carnae: Between the mountains and the deser, the territory of Carnae is all that remains from once-powerful Suhaman Empiurate.
Lunedale: These valleys host the most major cities of the state of North Affrancia, including the cradle of Affrancian civilization, Avinon.
March of Auverne: Rolling hills and fertile land surround the city of Auverne, a major economic centre of South Affrancia.
Vense: A state at the western edge of the Avar desert, Vense's cities and settlements shine bright as jewels among the sandy dunes.
